title: Name from Symbol
short: Given a symbol, name the element.
trouble: Confusing the symbol's language (Latin names) with the English name.

blocks.html: The periodic table is a map you can read. This drill works on given a symbol, name the element.
Tip: Say the symbol out loud — most are just the first letters of the name; the surprises are the Latin ones.
Questions are generated from the published element data — the same numbers the Periodic table dataset shows.
